name: Darwin Sessions Ingest (Calendly)
description: Single writer for Calendly research sessions into Supabase calendar_research_sessions. CD = the CD event type only. Upsert on (session_type, external_id). Sub-workflow. DWN-6.

nodes.name: Is New Booking Of A Reschedule?

parameters.content:
## Darwin Sessions Ingest (Calendly)
Single writer for research sessions booked through Calendly. Replaces Darwin CD Ingest (Calendly) and PF Calendly Capture. The UXR Calendly Booking Webhook stays as it is.

- `session_type = continuous_discovery` if and only if the event type is the CD event (`cdEventTypeUuid` in PF Config, https://calendly.com/d/dz6d-wr6-6bf/research-with-n8n). Otherwise `research`.
- **Store:** Supabase `calendar_research_sessions` (migration 20261027090000), credential "Supabase Postgres".
- **Upsert key:** `(session_type, external_id = event URI)`, the same key as the old CD ingest, so both can run at the same time.
- Cancel and reschedule set `canceled_at` (first value kept) and link old and new rows. Follow-up columns are never reset here.
- `is_mock` = PF Config `mockMode` (true on staging).
- The Calendly Trigger lives in a separate workflow (production only).

parameters.query:
SELECT id, booking_status, canceled_at, followup_status, booking_link
FROM calendar_research_sessions
WHERE session_type = $1 AND external_id = $2
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO calendar_research_sessions
  (session_type, source, external_id, organizer_name, organizer_email, title, description,
   starts_at, ends_at, canceled_at, raw_payload,
   invitee_uri, event_type_uri, source_kind, batch_id, booking_status,
   rescheduled_from, rescheduled_to, cancel_reason, booking_link,
   participant_name, participant_first_name, participant_email,
   followup_status, is_mock, updated_at)
VALUES
  ($1, $2, $3, NULLIF($4, ''), NULLIF($5, ''), NULLIF($6, ''), $7,
   $8::timestamptz, $9::timestamptz, NULLIF($10, '')::timestamptz, $11::jsonb,
   $12, NULLIF($13, ''), NULLIF($14, ''), NULLIF($15, ''), $16,
   NULLIF($17, ''), NULLIF($18, ''), NULLIF($19, ''), NULLIF($20, ''),
   NULLIF($21, ''), NULLIF($22, ''), NULLIF($23, ''),
   NULLIF($24, ''), $25::boolean, now())
ON CONFLICT (session_type, external_id) DO UPDATE SET
  organizer_name         = EXCLUDED.organizer_name,
  organizer_email        = EXCLUDED.organizer_email,
  title                  = EXCLUDED.title,
  description            = EXCLUDED.description,
  starts_at              = EXCLUDED.starts_at,
  ends_at                = EXCLUDED.ends_at,
  raw_payload            = EXCLUDED.raw_payload,
  -- Keep the first cancel time. A late duplicate never moves it.
  canceled_at            = COALESCE(calendar_research_sessions.canceled_at, EXCLUDED.canceled_at),
  invitee_uri            = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.invitee_uri, calendar_research_sessions.invitee_uri),
  event_type_uri         = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.event_type_uri, calendar_research_sessions.event_type_uri),
  source_kind            = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.source_kind, calendar_research_sessions.source_kind),
  batch_id               = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.batch_id, calendar_research_sessions.batch_id),
  booking_status         = EXCLUDED.booking_status,
  rescheduled_from       = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.rescheduled_from, calendar_research_sessions.rescheduled_from),
  rescheduled_to         = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.rescheduled_to, calendar_research_sessions.rescheduled_to),
  cancel_reason          = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.cancel_reason, calendar_research_sessions.cancel_reason),
  booking_link           = COALESCE(calendar_research_sessions.booking_link, EXCLUDED.booking_link),
  participant_name       = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.participant_name, calendar_research_sessions.participant_name),
  participant_first_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.participant_first_name, calendar_research_sessions.participant_first_name),
  participant_email      = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.participant_email, calendar_research_sessions.participant_email),
  -- Never reset the follow-up. Only set it when the row has none yet.
  followup_status        = COALESCE(calendar_research_sessions.followup_status, EXCLUDED.followup_status),
  is_mock                = EXCLUDED.is_mock,
  updated_at             = now()
RETURNING id, invitee_uri, booking_status, followup_status;

-- The old booking of a reschedule. Rows that only the old CD ingest wrote have no
-- invitee_uri, so also match them by the event URI (the invitee URI starts with it).
UPDATE calendar_research_sessions
SET booking_status = 'rescheduled',
    rescheduled_to = $2,
    canceled_at    = COALESCE(canceled_at, now()),
    updated_at     = now()
WHERE invitee_uri = $1
   OR (invitee_uri IS NULL AND external_id = split_part($1, '/invitees/', 1))
RETURNING id;

nodeGroups.description: For the new booking of a reschedule, marks the old row rescheduled and keeps its first canceled_at.
